# GitHub Copilot Adapter

Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository agreement. Copilot surfaces that support agent instructions load it automatically.

If this repository-wide file is the only instruction file available:
- inspect the current branch, Git tree, and existing files before editing;
- apply `.ai/CONTEXT_BUDGET.md`, then select one primary workflow from `.ai/skills/INDEX.md`;
- load only the relevant rules, approved requirements, and affected source;
- never edit generated files under `resource/html/` or `release/`;
- run applicable validation and report every check not run.
